schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 008A - Project Relocation Identity

questions.label: If canonical folder path is the project ID, what happens after relocation?
questions.help: Recommended: keep the original canonical path as the stable project key, and store the relocated current path as an alias/current location. This preserves chat history identity while allowing the folder to move.
options: Original canonical path remains the stable key; relocated path becomes current location
Relocated canonical path replaces the project ID and sessions are migrated
Relocation creates a new project and old sessions stay under the missing old path

questions.label: How should missing project sessions behave?
questions.help: Recommended: project row muted/gray with strike-through; sessions remain visible but read-only until relocated or removed.
options: Muted project row with strike-through; sessions visible read-only until relocated
Hide sessions until project is relocated
Allow sessions but block only file/runtime actions

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether the relocate action should validate the new folder, update recent workspaces, or preserve old path history.
